title: Exponential machine bound
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ and natural numbers $n$ and $s$, define $K_N(n,s)=2^{c(N)(s+L(n)+1)}$, where $c(N)$ is the machine code parameter and $L(n)$ is the logarithmic quantity used in the definition.
caveat: The supplied context does not define the machine code parameter or the logarithmic quantity, so their precise meanings cannot be stated from the given material.
